planner.question: Can the exact quadratic adversary family establish cubic-stage failure, or is its surviving-index reconstruction already fast enough to be covered by U?
planner.strategy: Read actual normalized selector tape in order, extract both forbidden streams and pins, reconstruct a surviving index in a single synchronized scan.
planner.alternative: Charge the fixed general program simulation and prove the leading-exponent ceiling for the prior adversary family.
planner.stop_rule: No extrapolation of the family upper bound to general SAT and no new lower-bound exponent.
literature_leads: Prior exact quadratic-stage theorem and ordinary polynomial-overhead fixed multitape-to-one-tape simulation; no novelty claim for stream intersection.

construct.claim: Every satisfiable member of the exact previous quadratic adversary family succeeds by stage 2 ceil(log2 L)+O(log log L) for the same U.
construct.scope: Same U and its weighted stages, entire previous n=11m disjointness-and-pins family with arbitrary forbidden masks and pins; no arbitrary-SAT runtime upper bound.
construct.derivation: Exact stream extraction from actual pool, lockstep surviving-index search, direct prior witness reconstruction; charge fixed multitape and quadratic three-symbol one-tape simulation and fixed description length.
unresolved_steps: Unconditional unbounded cubic failures for arbitrary selectors or a universal cutoff.

candidate_tests: Actual parent family encoding, original verifier, independent full-selector stream reference at m=3,4,5.

alternative.claim: For every fixed epsilon>0 the previous family has no failures at stage ceil((2+epsilon)log2 L) eventually, so the previous quadratic lower-bound family is sharp in leading stage exponent.
alternative.scope: Same U and its weighted stages, entire previous n=11m disjointness-and-pins family with arbitrary forbidden masks and pins; no arbitrary-SAT runtime upper bound.
alternative.derivation: Absorb additive logarithmic-logarithmic stage overhead into any fixed positive exponent slack. Compare with previous exact stage-two lower bound.
unresolved_steps: Find a genuinely different unbounded cubic adversary or a uniform cutoff.
